settings.heading: Three steps, one very smug pet
Every bandana starts as a drawing
settings.text:
No clip art, no templates. I sketch each design by hand, colour it in soft pink, yellow and green, and print it onto cotton that survives the park, the beach and the bath.

Your pet's name goes on properly — not slapped on as an afterthought.
I sent one photo and a sentence about her being dramatic. What came back was so her that I cried a bit.

settings.text: The colours are soft but they really pop in photos. He has three now. I have a problem.

settings.author: Tom & Nala

settings.question: How long does a custom bandana take?
settings.answer: I draw and print to order, so allow 3–5 working days before it's posted. UK delivery is usually 2–3 days after that.

settings.question: What size should I choose?
settings.answer: Measure your pet's neck and add about 5cm. If you're between sizes, go up — the tie-on style is forgiving.

settings.question: Can I send a photo of my pet?
settings.answer: Please do. Order first, then email your photos with your order number and I'll match the drawing to them.

settings.question: How do I wash it?
settings.answer: Cold machine wash inside out, hang to dry. Don't tumble dry and don't iron directly over the print.
